Showers may occur at several places in the sea areas off the coast extending from Batticaloa to Colombo
via Hambantota and Galle.

Winds will be north-easterly. Wind speed will be (30-40) kmph. Wind speed can increase up to (50-55)
kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Balapitiya to Mannar via Colombo, Puttalam
and from Matara to Batticaloa via Hambantota.

The sea areas off the coast extending from Balapitiya to Mannar via Colombo, Puttalam and from Matara
to Batticaloa via Hambantota will be rough at times. The other sea areas around the island will be
moderate.
